repo_prior_art.cite: none; the closest catalogue entry eid_lingam_direction_min_order_v1 concerns algebraic LiNGAM recovery, not an attainable residual-HSIC/GENE image.

published_prior_art.cite: pmlr-v267-li25bx defines GENE and gives an ordering condition, while PetersMJS2014 gives qualitative restricted-ANM identification; neither states a local feasible-image rectangle or Jacobian result.
Jin2026LiNGAM gives a bivariate linear-LiNGAM minimax law in primitive margins, not a legal nonlinear restricted-ANM swapped-orientation pair with residual-HSIC and information both of order lambda.
AcharyaBhadaneBhattacharyyaKandasamySun2023 studies a finite-alphabet observational-interventional experiment; it does not cover exact recovery over a product of observational nonlinear ANM pairs.

Mooijetal16 establishes consistency with a suitable regression procedure, and ShekharKimRamdas2023 studies observed-variable cross-HSIC; neither supplies the specified uniform generated-residual construction.
No inspected source gives matching exact-recovery bounds on this attainable nonlinear residual-HSIC product class with generated residuals.
WangKolarDrton2026 already constructs asymptotically valid causal-order confidence sets; the proposed finite-sample product inversion and singleton boundary are the potentially new parts.
Mooijetal16 proves consistency for the bivariate fixed-kernel ANM-HSIC direction rule; the displayed local sample-complexity specialization is consequential only through the proposed frontier.

soundness_flags.label: prop:single-pair-reduction
soundness_flags.one_line: For d=1 the defined confidence rule still uses conditional-risk/GENE score lower bounds in addition to the two residual-HSIC intervals, so it does not reduce merely to inversion of two residual-independence queries as claimed.

accepted_scope_caveats.label: thm:uniform-minimax-frontier and thm:simultaneous-graph-confidence-set
accepted_scope_caveats.caveat: The matching upper frontier and singleton-confidence conclusion are conditional on affirmatively constructing the specified A_n^LP generated-residual statistic and its joint regression/deviation event.
accepted_scope_caveats.bound_claim: The unconditional headline is the attainable-rectangle/mirror/product-converse lower-bound program; upper and confidence claims are only conditional on the OEQ construction.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 2022, Definition 18 and Condition 19; p. 2024, Definition 27 and Theorem 28
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Condition 19 defines identifiable bivariate ANMs; Theorem 28 identifies a restricted ANM graph under causal minimality.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 15, fixed-kernel score and consistency statement; pp. 51-52, Appendix A Theorem 20
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper proves convergence of fitted-residual HSIC to population HSIC and consistency under bounded Lipschitz characteristic-kernel and suitable-regression conditions.
The proceedings version introduces GENE for nonlinear ANMs and describes its order-based use of conditional-independence tests.
The paper studies finite-domain two-variable causal-structure identification with observational and interventional samples and derives tradeoff bounds in a TV-correlation experiment.
The paper constructs permutation-free cross-HSIC for i.i.d. observed pairs, with Gaussian null calibration and smooth-local-alternative minimax results.
The published article uses residual-bootstrap goodness-of-fit tests to construct asymptotically valid confidence sets of causal orderings under identifiable additive-error SEMs.
The preprint states a sharp bivariate linear-LiNGAM sample-complexity law in edge strength, non-Gaussianity, and scale uncertainty.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Correct the d=1 proposition: either retain the conditional-risk/GENE score as part of the reduction, or define and analyze a separate pure two-HSIC inversion rule.
Add a theorem-level exact-versus-coordinatewise recovery corollary on the same mirror family, explicitly isolating the log d penalty from the log(1/alpha) penalty.
Resolve the OEQ for the fixed local-polynomial protocol, or state a provable slower nuisance-limited upper rate; that turns the conditional bracket into a complete field-level minimax frontier.

recommended_next_step: Revise the invalid single-pair sanity reduction, retain the accepted conditional upper-bound scope, then advance the field-tier attainable-geometry and product-converse kernel to Stage 0.
